#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int to, rev;
        ll cap, cost;
        Edge(int to, int rev, ll cap, ll cost) : to(to), rev(rev), cap(cap), cost(cost) {}
    };

    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    vector<ll> h, dist;
    vector<int> prevv, preve;

    MinCostFlow(int n) {
        g.resize(n);
        h.assign(n, 0);
        dist.assign(n, 0);
        prevv.assign(n, 0);
        preve.assign(n, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, ll cap, ll cost) {
        g[from].push_back(Edge(to, (int)g[to].size(), cap, cost));
        g[to].push_back(Edge(from, (int)g[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }

    pair<ll, ll> minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t, ll maxf) {
        ll flow = 0, cost = 0;
        fill(h.begin(), h.end(), 0);
        while (flow < maxf) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), LLONG_MAX);
            dist[s] = 0;
            // Binary heap implementation
            vector<int> heap(g.size());
            vector<ll> heapDist(g.size());
            vector<int> pos(g.size(), -1);
            int heapSize = 0;
            heap[heapSize] = s;
            heapDist[heapSize] = 0;
            pos[s] = heapSize;
            heapSize++;
            while (heapSize > 0) {
                int u = heap[0];
                ll du = heapDist[0];
                // remove min
                heapSize--;
                heap[0] = heap[heapSize];
                heapDist[0] = heapDist[heapSize];
                pos[heap[0]] = 0;
                // sift down
                int idx = 0;
                while (true) {
                    int left = 2 * idx + 1;
                    int right = 2 * idx + 2;
                    int smallest = idx;
                    if (left < heapSize && heapDist[left] < heapDist[smallest]) smallest = left;
                    if (right < heapSize && heapDist[right] < heapDist[smallest]) smallest = right;
                    if (smallest == idx) break;
                    // swap
                    swap(heap[idx], heap[smallest]);
                    swap(heapDist[idx], heapDist[smallest]);
                    pos[heap[idx]] = idx;
                    pos[heap[smallest]] = smallest;
                    idx = smallest;
                }
                if (du != dist[u]) continue; // outdated
                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[u].size(); i++) {
                    Edge &e = g[u][i];
                    if (e.cap > 0) {
                        int v = e.to;
                        ll nd = dist[u] + e.cost + h[u] - h[v];
                        if (dist[v] > nd) {
                            dist[v] = nd;
                            prevv[v] = u;
                            preve[v] = i;
                            if (pos[v] == -1) {
                                // add to heap
                                heap[heapSize] = v;
                                heapDist[heapSize] = nd;
                                pos[v] = heapSize;
                                heapSize++;
                                // sift up
                                int cur = heapSize - 1;
                                while (cur > 0) {
                                    int parent = (cur - 1) / 2;
                                    if (heapDist[parent] <= heapDist[cur]) break;
                                    swap(heap[cur], heap[parent]);
                                    swap(heapDist[cur], heapDist[parent]);
                                    pos[heap[cur]] = cur;
                                    pos[heap[parent]] = parent;
                                    cur = parent;
                                }
                            } else {
                                // update
                                int cur = pos[v];
                                heapDist[cur] = nd;
                                while (cur > 0) {
                                    int parent = (cur - 1) / 2;
                                    if (heapDist[parent] <= heapDist[cur]) break;
                                    swap(heap[cur], heap[parent]);
                                    swap(heapDist[cur], heapDist[parent]);
                                    pos[heap[cur]] = cur;
                                    pos[heap[parent]] = parent;
                                    cur = parent;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == LLONG_MAX) break;
            for (int v = 0; v < (int)g.size(); v++) {
                if (dist[v] < LLONG_MAX) h[v] += dist[v];
            }
            ll d = maxf - flow;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                d = min(d, g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
            }
            flow += d;
            cost += d * h[t];
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
                Edge &e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= d;
                g[v][e.rev].cap += d;
            }
        }
        return make_pair(cost, flow);
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {
        // nothing
    }

    int readInt() {
        int c = getchar();
        while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1) c = getchar();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = getchar(); }
        int res = 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = getchar();
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }

    string readString() {
        int c = getchar();
        while (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1) c = getchar();
        string res;
        while (c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != '\t' && c != -1) {
            res.push_back((char)c);
            c = getchar();
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    int n = in.readInt();
    string s = in.readString();
    vector<int> ugliness(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        ugliness[i] = -in.readInt();
    }

    int V = 1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1;
    MinCostFlow mcf(V);
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            int cost = 0;
            if (c == s[i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
            }
            if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                cost = min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
            }
            mcf.addEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, 1, cost);
        }
    }

    int occurs[128] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) occurs[s[i]]++;
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
        mcf.addEdge(0, 1 + (c - 'a'), occurs[c], 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        mcf.addEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n / 2, 2, 0);
    }

    pair<ll, ll> result = mcf.minCostMaxFlow(0, 1 + 26 + n / 2, n);
    cout << -result.first << endl;

    return 0;
}
